answer: Sybil resistance arises because EigenTrust-style matrix factorization assigns influence through trusted, reciprocity-weighted paths rather than identity count. Reputation decays exponentially with a defined half-life, so even established accounts must provide sustained honest service to retain weight. Fresh identities—whether labeled ferrous, knoll, or nadir—start with near-zero eigenvector centrality and, lacking trusted endorsements, cannot accumulate enough consensus influence to pass decisions.
